Leo's Little Lines – My First Tracing Book (Ages 2–4)

Big, friendly dotted lines for little hands! Trace along with Leo the Little Explorer through soft pastel pages that build the very first pre-writing skills, one gentle step at a time.

Inside the book

  • 12 warm-up line pages – straight, slanted, wavy, zig-zag, hops, arches, circles, loops and swirls
  • 10 shape pages – circle, square, triangle, rectangle, oval, star, heart, diamond, a shape house and a shape parade
  • 8 follow-the-path pages – help Leo walk home, sail to the boat and fly to the balloon
  • 10 number pages (1–10) – trace the number, then count and colour the pictures
  • 26 letter pages (A–Z) – trace the big letter, then colour a picture that starts with it
  • Green start dots and arrows on every line, a grown-up guide, a progress map, a certificate and a free-drawing page

What you receive

  • Printable PDF in US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) and A4 – 73 pages each (cover + 72 activity pages)
  • A one-page Start Here printing guide

Please note

  • Digital product – no physical item is shipped.
  • Print at Actual size / 100%. Crayons or pencils work best; markers may bleed through paper.
  • Age guidance: 2–4 years with a grown-up. Please supervise young children with crayons and pencils.
  • Licence: personal / single-household use. Please don't share or resell the files.
  • Product images show actual pages; book-style images are digital mockups.
